acceptanceCriteria: Reproduce or rule out: an absolute --map path below --root either works like its relative form or the ticket is closed with evidence.
If reproduced, an absolute --map below --root behaves like the relative path and one outside --root exits with an error naming --map.
body: Suspected, not reproduced. V1-1997 (PR #1261, DCP-V1-205..207) taught cmd/corvint-corpus-mcp/main.go to rewrite an absolute --artifact below --root to a root-relative path, because doccorpus.ReadCorpusFile's LocalInputPathRule refuses paths starting with '/'. The lane reports that --map paths probably reach the same reader and would fail the same way (surfacing as repository unavailable, see V1-1992).
title: Suspected: corvint-corpus-mcp --map rejects an absolute path below --root, like --artifact did before #1256
